 Gary Rose, Sam Drury and Jess Anderson
 Show Most recent Most popular Arsenal 'controlling the speed' published at 15:35 BST 15:35 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I don't think Arsenal are in a hurry. 
 They're comfortable and there seem to be gears there but they're in reserve - they go through them once or twice every five or 10 minutes but they are controlling the speed here. 
 5 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:34 BST 15:34 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Corner number six for Arsenal brings about corner number seven.
 Everton, after a good spell, are under the pump again.
 Jordan Pickford punches the set piece away but a needless foul from Brennan Johnson gives Arsenal a free-kick in a good position on the left.
 The visitors have to prepare for another ball flung into the box...
 18 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:33 BST 15:33 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Here comes Josh King on the left. A few stepovers and he is into the box but then he can't get past Bobby Thomas, who shrugs him off the ball as he attempts to run past the Coventry man.
 43 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:32 BST 15:32 BST 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 My FPL is taking a hiding already! Can we blame it on the weather? Pickford to save a pen, but Gabriel gets the rebound please. I'll even settle for a Pickford equaliser.
 Kev, Belfast 
 61 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 15:32 BST 15:32 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Close again for Arsenal.
 This time Noni Madueke plucks the ball out of the sky as Everton can only half-clear, spins and sends a shot into the side netting.
 Jordan Pickford didn't move. Had that crept the other side of the post, the Everton keeper was beaten.
 163 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:30 BST 15:30 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 When Arsenal play quickly around the box, it's very hard for Everton make sure they're in the right position in every moment. 
 Arsenal are only looking for that half a yard and Merino got that there.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 171 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 15:30 BST 15:30 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Crucial block from Jake O'Brien to prevent Arsenal doubling their lead!
 Arsenal have worked their way back on top, get the ball into the right channel and when it's pulled back, Mikel Merino is arriving onto it.
 HIs side-footed effort looks destined for the net before O'Brien throws himself in front of it.
 125 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:29 BST 15:29 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Antonee Robinson miscues an attempted clearance and Brandon Thomas-Asante looks to be in, but he sends his shot wide. Robinson did well to recover and do enough to put Thomas-Asante off.
 27 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:28 BST 15:28 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Lovely little pass around the corner from Declan Rice to find Noni Madueke.
 The Arsenal winger drives into the box but drags his right-foot shot wide.
 A decent chance that.
 210 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:28 BST 15:28 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Matt Grimes overhits a pretty routine pass to Jay Dasilva and the ball goes out of play.
 It hasn't been a classic here.
 19 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Home form is everything for Coventry' published at 15:25 BST 15:25 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 I think it's going to be difficult for them. The gulf between the Championship and the Premier League is still very different. 
 You're off the back of two wins, and then you lose against Tottenham, if you can bounce back with a win straight after it, you stand a chance of surviving. 
 The home form is everything. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 105 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:24 BST 15:24 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Sweeping move from Arsenal but Eberechi Eze scuffs the shot wide of the far post at the end of it.
 154 105 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 BST 15:22 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Important clearance on the stretch from Merlin Rohl to divert a deep cross away from Viktor Gyokeres.
 Arsenal have another corner. And another. But Everton deal with them well enough.
 185 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 BST 15:22 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's almost as if Arsenal expected Everton to roll over once they got the goal but it hasn't happened. 
 187 197 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 BST 15:21 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Better from Coventry as Brandon Thomas-Asante gets away from his marker to meet a cross but sends his header over.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 63 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 BST 15:21 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Arsenal come forward for the first time since going in front and Mikel Merino's clever pass finds Ben White in space at the back post.
 He doesn't want to take on the shot, lays the ball off to Martin Odegaard and he opts against shooting as well.
 That gives Everton time to get men back and crowd the Gunners out.
 97 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Everton are back in this game' published at 15:19 BST 15:19 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 Their response has brilliant, at the start of the game they allowed Arsenal to come onto them. 
 But Everton are back in this game in terms of confidence. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 216 211 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 George 'looking the most dangerous' published at 15:19 BST 15:19 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Tyrique George is afraid of absolutely no-one, he'll take you on, ask the question and if he gets it wrong, he'll do the same again next time. 
 It's great to see that belief and confidence and also the backing of his manager to do that. He's looking the most dangerous. 
 171 101 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 BST 15:18 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 This time it's Arsenal scrambling to defend a corner.
 Not entirely convincing as David Raya tries to punch but fails to get the ball away.
 It bobbles back towards goal and Gabriel has to hack it away off the line.
 130 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 15:18 BST 15:18 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 So close for Fulham!
 Josh King is given far too much space inside the box and he shoots, smashing the ball against the woodwork. The rebound falls to Alex Iwobi but he flashes his effort wide.
 A let off for Coventry.
